title: GitHub Trending Summary - Daily - 2026-10-23
ranking_basis: Daily GitHub Trending star gains for eight repositories; three newly created, active repositories from the two-day discovery window are appended by current star count, without daily star-gain claims.
ranking_explanation: The first eight repositories are ordered by the stars-today figures on GitHub Trending captured at 2026-10-23 16:34 UTC. The last three were found via GitHub Search with created:2026-10-21..2026-10-23 and stars:>100, then ordered by current total stars. GitHub Search does not provide comparable daily gains for those additions.
global_caveat: Trending star gains are a short-window snapshot and do not establish sustained adoption or project quality. Total stars, descriptions, languages, default branches, and latest default-branch commit SHAs were corroborated through the public GitHub REST API. The three recently created repositories are supplemental discoveries, not part of the daily Trending star-gain ranking.

sections.title: Snapshot
sections.content: Snapshot time (UTC): 2026-10-23 16:34 UTC. Scope: Daily. Date range: 2026-10-23 through 2026-10-23. Daily Trending gains rank the first eight entries; three repositories created during 2026-10-21 through 2026-10-23 are appended by current total stars, without daily gains.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Agent security is today's clearest trend: Cloudflare's multi-stage audit skill leads the captured Trending list, with NVIDIA's policy-enforcing runtime also drawing strong interest. The snapshot also spans open-source knowledge-work plugins, speech generation, and several newly created developer tools.

sections.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
sections.description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings.
sections.content: A coding-agent workflow that separates reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, structured output, independent record verification, and target-neutral reporting.
sections.why_notable: Led the captured daily Trending list and turns agent-assisted auditing into an explicit, coverage-tracked verification pipeline.

sections.title: NVIDIA/OpenShell
sections.description: OpenShell is the safe, private runtime for autonomous AI agents.
sections.content: An agent runtime using isolated sandboxes, kernel-level policy enforcement, credential mediation, and formal verification of policy changes.
sections.why_notable: Its strong daily gain highlights demand for runtime isolation, credential handling, and reviewable access policies around agents.
sections.unique_caveat: The README lists Windows support through WSL 2 as experimental.

sections.title: php/php-src
sections.content: The upstream PHP interpreter source repository.
sections.why_notable: A mature language runtime is among the day's strongest gainers; the trend signal alone does not establish why interest rose.

sections.title: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
sections.description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork
sections.content: Eleven role-specific plugins bundle skills, connectors, slash commands, and sub-agents for work such as sales, support, product, marketing, legal, finance, data, and research.
sections.why_notable: Its plugin bundles combine skills, commands, and external-tool connectors into customizable workflows for business functions.
sections.unique_caveat: The README says the collection is built for Claude Cowork and also compatible with Claude Code.

sections.title: Renhuai123/ziwei-doushu
sections.description: 紫微斗数开源排盘引擎 — 基于倪海厦《天纪》体系，含完整排盘算法、四化系统、格局知识库、古籍原文数据
sections.content: A TypeScript Zi Wei Dou Shu charting engine whose repository description lists chart calculations, transformation rules, a pattern knowledge base, and classical text data.
sections.why_notable: It is a standout non-agent, domain-specific project in today's Trending results.
sections.unique_caveat: It implements a traditional astrology framework; this repository trend signal is not evidence of predictive validity.

sections.title: SnailSploit/Claude-Red
sections.description: claude-red is a curated library of offensive security skills designed for the Claude skills system. Each skill is a structured SKILL.md file that primes Claude with expert-level methodology for a specific attack surface — from SQLi to shellcode, EDR evasion to exploit development.
sections.content: A structured library of offensive-security skills grouped by attack surface, intended for use with Claude skills.
sections.why_notable: It reflects interest in packaging specialist security workflows as agent-consumable skills.
sections.unique_caveat: Offensive-security content; use only in authorized environments.

sections.title: OpenBMB/VoxCPM
sections.description: VoxCPM2: Tokenizer-Free TTS for Multilingual Speech Generation, Creative Voice Design, and True-to-Life Cloning
sections.content: A tokenizer-free diffusion-autoregressive TTS system; its README describes VoxCPM2 as a 2B-parameter model supporting 30 languages, voice design, cloning, and 48 kHz output.
sections.why_notable: Its model-backed audio workflow is a strong counterpoint to the day's security and agent tooling.

sections.title: nodejs/node
sections.content: The JavaScript runtime maintained by the Node.js project.
sections.why_notable: The long-established runtime still attracts daily attention alongside newer agent-oriented tools.

sections.title: colinhacks/reylo
sections.description: Import .sql files into TypeScript with full type inference and zero codegen.
sections.content: A newly created tool that imports SQL files as TypeScript modules and derives query result types from the connected database without generated files.
sections.why_notable: Created during the two-day discovery window, it links SQL queries to inferred TypeScript types at compile time.
sections.unique_caveat: The README lists TypeScript 7.1 beta as a requirement.

sections.title: wesbos/3d-model-anything
sections.description: Capture iPhone LiDAR and photos, reconstruct editable Three.js rooms, and explore them in a browser.
sections.content: A recently created iPhone app that combines LiDAR and photos to reconstruct editable Three.js rooms for browser exploration.
sections.why_notable: It connects mobile depth capture to browser-based 3D editing and is active in the two-day creation window.

sections.title: xevrion/hatchzip
sections.description: Extract huge archives in place: the archive shrinks as your files hatch, so you only need room for the output. ZIP, 7z, tar, split archives.
sections.content: A recently created Rust utility for in-place extraction of ZIP, 7z, tar, and split archives, intended to limit extra storage needed during extraction.
sections.why_notable: A compact systems utility with a distinct storage-efficiency angle rounds out the new-project cohort.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agent security and control: Cloudflare's audit skill emphasizes coverage and independent verification; NVIDIA OpenShell confines agents using policies; Claude-Red is an adjacent dual-use skills library. Agent workflows as packaged software: Anthropic's role plugins and Cloudflare's skill package specialist procedures. Established runtimes and developer tooling: PHP and Node.js remain daily gainers; Reylo adds SQL-derived TypeScript type checking and Hatchzip targets in-place archive extraction. Applied AI and spatial tooling: VoxCPM focuses on multilingual speech synthesis; 3d-model-anything converts phone LiDAR and photos into editable web scenes. Zi Wei Dou Shu charting is a domain-specific outlier. Languages in the 11-repository sample: Python 3, Rust 3, JavaScript 2, and C, TypeScript, and Swift 1 each.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Today's repository mix points to a practical shift from agent capability alone toward the systems around it: audit workflows, permission boundaries, and role-specific integrations. At the same time, the strongest repositories are not all agents—speech synthesis, mature runtimes, SQL type tooling, and spatial applications remain visible. The three appended projects are recent-creation discoveries, not daily star-gain rankings.

sections.title: Sources and Method
sections.content: Primary source: GitHub Trending - Today at https://github.com/trending?since=daily, captured 2026-10-23 16:34 UTC. Corroboration: public GitHub REST API repository metadata and latest default-branch commits; GitHub Search API query created:2026-10-21..2026-10-23 stars:>100. The gh token was invalid, so REST calls were unauthenticated. First eight repositories are ordered by daily star gains shown on Trending. Last three created within the two-day discovery window are appended by current total stars with daily gains unavailable. No prior-window comparison was collected; no Notable Shifts section is included.
